description: PLAY-06 (owner play-test 2026-11-27): character creation showed the old starting-spec badge on each class icon («warrior starts as tank»). Before 15 every class uses the neutral training kit, so creation shows the plain class icon. PLAY-10 (same play-test): the quest card showed the new short retelling and the old line; it now shows only the retelling (goals stay); quests without a retelling keep their text. PLAY-09: retellings that named enemies the capped solo fight no longer spawns (murloc in the stew, gnolls in the goulash) are corrected. PLAY-13: the dungeon entrance icon (one icon for every instance) scales with the map (10% of its width, 44–60 px) instead of a fixed 72×55, and can be mirrored per map (DUNGEON_ENTRY_FLIP); approved art unchanged. PLAY-17 + PARTY-02: the companion picker (Deadmines lobby and ordinary party share it) drops the visible rarity/bonus line that spilled out of the cards (rarity colour kept; rarity and bonus stay in the accessible name and tooltip), and its filters take one compact row (role buttons, then rarity and sort side by side with short labels; select titles stay as accessible names).
